projects.name: Himpawid
projects.headline: Air quality. Made understandable.
projects.description: A team-built Flutter and Firebase app displaying location-based air quality, pollutant readings, and a color-coded map using OpenWeatherMap data.
features: Location-based air quality and pollutant readings
My contribution: coding and UI fixes, with development responsibilities shared across the team

projects.name: TrackGuard
projects.headline: Software meets the physical world.
projects.description: A team-built ESP32-CAM robot car combining infrared line-following, ultrasonic obstacle avoidance, and live video streaming.
features: Infrared line-following and ultrasonic obstacle avoidance
Live video streaming and manual IR remote override
My contribution: coding and debugging as part of the project team

projects.name: SmartClassSchedule
projects.headline: A little more order in student life.
projects.description: A team-built Kotlin Android app for managing class schedules, assignments, and exams by subject, with scheduled class and task reminders.
features: Class schedules, assignments, and exams organized by subject
My contribution: UI development and coding, including a weekday-tabbed dashboard for classes and upcoming tasks
